name: Direction 2
definition: Elements indicating the direction of the derivative transaction.

DirectionOfTheFirstLeg.name: Direction Of The First Leg
DirectionOfTheFirstLeg.definition: Identifies whether the reporting counterparty is the payer (Taker) or the receiver (Maker) of the first leg as determined at the time of transaction.

DirectionOfTheSecondLeg.name: Direction Of The Second Leg
DirectionOfTheSecondLeg.definition: Identifies whether the reporting counterparty is the payer (Taker) or the receiver (Maker) of the second leg as determined at the time of transaction.
